item.text: The current hasher stores opaque `maphash.Seed` values, which cannot be rebuilt from a caller’s string seed. I’ll store each ID’s seed as a string and hash it together with the input using the hasher’s shared `maphash` seed.

I’ll run the database and persistence tests next because those packages use the hashing function for random ordering.

item.text: The database and persistence tests pass. I found one reproducibility gap during review: separate `Hasher` instances still choose different internal `maphash` seeds, so the same explicit seed gives different hashes within one process. I’m making them share one process seed and adding a test for that case.

item.text:
Added per-ID `SetSeed` support to [hasher.go](/app/utils/hasher/hasher.go). Reseeding changes the hash, and restoring a previous seed restores the earlier result. A shared process seed also makes explicit seeds consistent across `Hasher` instances in the same process.

Added coverage in [hasher_test.go](/app/utils/hasher/hasher_test.go). The hasher, database, and persistence tests pass.
